items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: And Ray Heatherton, he did it with a choir, but for Decca.

ctx.x: Eddie Arnold. You know the fellow that so many records sell? He did it for Victor. And Ray Heatherton, he did it with a choir, but for Decca. So I've had some good songs, you know. I mean good people do my material.
